decisions.target_truth: Single kinship noun center is correct and sufficiently represented.

Center aural=relating to hearing/the ear. Keep the dictionary-attested aura-related homograph only as very low reference, not learner-main content. Remove the misleading example 'aural symptoms'=aura warning symptoms, because medical usage commonly uses aural symptoms for ear/hearing symptoms. Preserve the accurate aural↔oral confusable relation.
Use one learner center authentic=genuine/real/not false or counterfeit, with credibility/trustworthiness as the resulting application rather than a separate equal sense.
Keep noun author=writer, extended author=creator/originator, and verb author=write/create; all are useful and coherent.
Keep authority=power/right, the authorities=official bodies, an authority on=expert, and official authorization/permission; these are distinct high-value reading branches.
Keep automatic=self-operating and figurative automatic=unconscious/mechanical. Deprecated firearm noun stays outside the active learner center.
Single learner center automation=use/process/state of automatic technological control is sufficient; merged equipment/state residues do not require separate learner senses.
Keep automobile=car/road motor vehicle, but remove the outdated restriction that it must be powered by an internal-combustion engine; the definition must include electric automobiles.
Keep organizational/political self-government and personal autonomy/independence as two high-value contexts under one self-governance center.
Define autumn as the season between summer and winter. Do not define it by leaves falling from trees, which is not universally true across climates or vegetation.
Keep supporting/backup adjective, supporting person/thing noun, and grammatical auxiliary verb noun; current hierarchy is acceptable.

Center lexicalized to/of no avail=no use/no effect and formal avail oneself of=make use of. Downgrade rare intransitive avail against sth. Treat avail→available only as low-value morphology/history, not a semantic-neighbor shortcut.
Keep available=obtainable/usable and available=free/not busy; both are common familiar-word branches and correctly connected to availability.
Keep literal street/avenue and figurative avenue=route/means/channel; the spatial-to-abstract extension is high-value and clear.
Keep noun average, adjective average=mean/typical/ordinary, transitive calculate an average, and intransitive average at/amount to; current POS distinctions are useful.
Keep avert=prevent a bad event and avert eyes/face=turn away; both are common and distinct.

Compress current transport-operation and art/science-of-flying senses into one learner center aviation=activity, industry, technology or practice of flying aircraft. Keep military-aviation collective residue outside main Active content.
Keep avoid sb/sth=stay away from and avoid doing/prevent an outcome; the high-value construction is explicitly presentation-merged and not a competing semantic object.
Keep await=wait for while taking a direct object. Current deprecation of the obsolete/nonstandard await-for analysis is correct.

Center adjective awake=not asleep and preserve awake to sth=become/be aware of as a high-value familiar-word extension in Core/Word Feel. Keep literal verb wake/awaken and transitive awake sb/memories only at lower priority because they are less central in modern usage.

relation_truth.target_truth: Preserve: aural relates to hearing/the ear; oral is spoken or relates to the mouth. The similar form/sound makes this a genuine learner confusable.

notes: Truth-stage artifact only: no Word or Relation semantics were mutated.
The aural decision used contemporary learner-dictionary and medical-usage checks because the current example created a genuine factual ambiguity.
